newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 60 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 60 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.2 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 60 billion dong ($5.13 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.2 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on July 30, the central bank sold 81.6 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.3 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is August 8 and maturity will be on August 8, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 17.0 billion
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 15.0 billion
Technological and Commercial Joint-Stock Bank 10.0 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 8.0 billion
